points: Bridge your basic HTML knowledge into modern web development by building a small responsive project using React to meet the frontend requirements seen in GovTech software engineering roles.

Leverage your Python proficiency to learn backend framework fundamentals like Node.js or basic API development through building a simple CRUD application, aligning with the system design and backend needs of GovTech architectures.

Gain familiarity with Agile methodologies and requirements gathering techniques by documenting user stories for a personal coding project in a tool like Trello, preparing you for Business Analyst and Systems Analyst positions.
Complement your existing Python skills by taking an introductory cloud computing tutorial on AWS to understand serverless patterns and cloud architecture basics required by cloud-focused internships.
